description: Planar walk with MIXED-SIGN vectors: not a chairman instance. Each entry is [h_1, h_2, w]; a column moves the point by +(1-w)h or by -w h, and the cost is the largest sup norm of a prefix point. The exact min-max is 15/14 > 1. This shows that the non-negative weights are necessary in Theorem 3 of notes/two_rows.md.
